sources.snippet: SmartBinX is an AI-powered e-waste management application that helps identify electronic waste using Computer Vision and provides detailed material composition along with recycling recommendations. The application is built using Python, Streamlit, TensorFlow, and CNN to promote sustainable electronic waste disposal through intelligent classification.

sources.snippet: ♻️ Smart Bin AI - Waste Detection System An intelligent waste classification system using YOLO11 computer vision and Streamlit for real-time waste material detection. This AI-powered solution automatically identifies and categorizes waste materials to promote proper recycling and waste management.
